card.name: The word man before -made
card.fires_on: Mostly on "man" right before "-made" in "man-made" (islands, ponds, habitat). Also fires on a few spots inside long drug names or other words where "artificial" or "synthetic" could come next.

modes.label: Before synthetic or artificial
modes.description: A spot right before a word meaning synthetic or artificial in a passage about artificial things.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning artificial or synthetic, in English, Chinese and Russian.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say something is artificial or human-made, most often on the word "man" in "man-made".
